## Why this change matters

Describe the learner, research, vehicle-evidence, accessibility, or maintenance problem this addresses.

## What changed

Explain the result in plain language. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Evidence and sources

List the sources, measurements, assumptions, and applicable E34 variant. Mark estimates and provisional values clearly.

## How it was checked

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:e2e` for an interaction change, or explained why it is not applicable.
- [ ] I checked keyboard and narrow-screen behavior for an interface change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where the expected result changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation, attribution, and status notes where needed.

## Boundaries

What does this change still not establish, teach, or simulate?
